statement: SDL tolerates a failed user-stick 0x8010 SPI read, but **requires** successful factory-stick 0x603D read to open; absent B2 A1 magic picks factory fields. Extracted 12-bit center/max/min equal to 0xFFF are replaced by synthetic center 2048 and max/min fractions. On failed factory IMU read it supplies default scale, rather than blocking open.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_switch.c 936-1026, 1028-1090, 1536-1551. The IMU user-scale condition is source-specific and should be regression-tested; no universal all-0xFF recovery guarantee.
